- 移除 skill-card.md 文件，不再包含该说明卡片
- 其他功能和说明保持不变

Initial release of 菜谱查询工具:

- Supports querying recipe menus and dish details via command line.
- Requires an API key; prompts user if missing.
- Provides two main functions: listing all dish names and fetching detailed content for a specific dish.
- Ensures all requests and user queries follow a clear workflow with strict parameter checks.
